overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Weston Plan Commission was scheduled to meet to review several development projects including a preliminary condominium plat, an amended final plat for a subdivision, and to discuss compliance with conditional use permits. The commission was also set to review staff-approved certifications and building permits from August 2026.

discussions.item: Project #20260315 – Preliminary Condominium Plat Review for 4603, 4605, 4607, 4609, 4611 and 4613 Camp Phillips Road
discussions.body: The Plan Commission was scheduled to review a preliminary condominium plat for six properties on Camp Phillips Road. Staff was expected to present analysis and recommendations regarding the plat's compliance with Village zoning and development standards.

discussions.item: Project #20250424 – Amended Final Plat of Bull Junior View Subdivision (Reedy Builders/Vreeland)
discussions.body: The commission was set to consider an amended final plat for the Bull Junior View Subdivision involving Reedy Builders and Vreeland. The meeting was expected to include staff review and potential action on the amended plat submission.

discussions.item: Discussion and possible action regarding compliance with approved conditional use permits
discussions.body: The Plan Commission was scheduled to discuss identified violations of approved conditional use permits for three properties: USSAM at 3107 Concord Avenue (CUP No. 20240072), BUG Properties at 6406 Schofield Avenue (CUP No. 1890229), and Tommy's Car Wash at 1611 Schofield Avenue (CUP No. 20191300). The commission was expected to consider possible modification, revocation, or other appropriate action for these properties.

discussions.item: August 2026 Staff-Approved Certified Survey Maps and Site Plans
discussions.body: The commission was scheduled to review a report on certified survey maps and site plans that were approved by staff during August 2026. This informational item was set for commission awareness and record.
The Plan Commission was set to receive a report on building permits issued in August 2026. This was expected to serve as an informational update for commission members.

discussions.item: Planning & Development Department Monthly Project Update Report
discussions.body: Staff was scheduled to present the monthly project update report from the Planning & Development Department. This report was expected to provide an overview of ongoing projects and departmental activities.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda through both a general open public comment period and remote participation options via Zoom.
